title: Shooting Stars
blurb: Bag Raiders put this out in 2009 and it did modest business, an Australian electro track with a chorus built for driving at night. Then in early 2017 somebody paired it with footage of a man falling, edited so that he tumbled off into a starfield. The format ran for months. Anybody stumbling, jumping badly or losing their footing got the same treatment. The song became inseparable from the joke — to the mild bemusement of the duo who wrote it. Years later, people still cannot hear the intro without expecting somebody to drop out of frame.
origin: 'Shooting Stars' by Australian duo Bag Raiders, released as a single in 2009 and turned into a falling-video meme in early 2017.
